content.text: I'll build this as a Spring Boot service with a clean structure: each thing that varies by case (delivery option, coupon, club level, payment method) gets its own class behind a small interface, looked up by code — no if/switch chains to add when a new delivery partner shows up. Region only varies by a percentage number, so that's a plain lookup table, not a strategy.
